test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Atharv is married to Chetna, who is the only sister of Dilip. Chetna's paternal grandfather is Mukul. Neha is married to Mukul and they have two sons, Hardik and Bhavesh. Hardik is unmarried. Anjali is the daughter-in-law of Neha. Gyan is the son of Dilip and Ekta. How is Chetna related to Gyan?
solution:
Family Chart :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acf828852e3a12d6e15239ebf504bf9fca0749295780543ad4d3c6e56ac43fc6.png] 

According to the given information:-

1) Atharv is married to Chetna, who is the only sister of Dilip.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb65e31ea0e12c7f865741fdf1b5a5570f5933dc9f5fb2c830a06c6b88574443.png] 

2) Gyan is the son of Dilip and Ekta.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/228d9b4a54007f8d0a93f6cf2afaa36c6b71a120342186f60472eb3fd570fad3.png] 

3) Neha is married to Mukul and they have two sons, Hardik and Bhavesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98abd8fa204105b648aa2af12baa8bae754b3f476c77b27a509f6608d69689c8.png] 

4) Hardik is unmarried. Anjali is the daughter-in-law of Neha.

So Anjali is married to Bhavesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b9002681790e474620110c07dee428a917dabd265c31e679098d74fe0356c1d.png] 

5) Chetna's paternal grandfather is Mukul.

So, Mukul is a male and Neha is a female.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15743b82fdde38d92c03f6da1f6536e6612e7371c584c2dbf8d963814268b507.png] 

∴ Here, 'Chetna is aunt of Gyan from the family tree'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Aunt".**
